skills.name: brand-palette-roles

showcase.value: Brands hand over one to four colours; a deck or report needs about a dozen. This skill derives the rest in a fixed, checkable way, so every slide uses named roles and the result is readable before anyone looks.

howItWorks.title: A few brand seeds become eleven checked roles

workflow: Collect the brand's seed colours and the look (light or dark).
Run palette.mjs with the seeds; it reports every role and every contrast check.
Fix any failing pair by changing a seed or the look, never by hand-editing a role.
Emit the roles as CSS variables or PowerPoint theme colour slots.

Run the style checklist on the diff or a screenshot before review.
